en.description:
In Home Behind, you take on the role of a refugee cast out from your homeland by a band of rebels. Your home and the peace you enjoyed has been destroyed, and your family has disappeared. Can you survive the struggle, famine, and sickness to make it to the safety of Europe?


The thoughts of civil war had been brewing in your homeland for years, and the violence has finally erupted. In the chaos, your village was burned to the ground, and your daughter disappeared. When faced with death, you chose to survive and to overcome the difficulties of disease, war, and famine. Can you make it long enough to be reunited with your daughter?


-All events and experiences you come across are randomly generated, so no play through is exactly the same! 
-Keep track of your mood, nutrition, and water levels while avoiding terrible diseases! 
-Take on the ultimate struggle of survival as your travel 1500 kilometers to safety.
-Unlock all 15 jobs, each with their own special starting skills, items and rewards. 
-Experience tons of random events both in the outside world and indoors, and be the master of your destiny. 
-Survive both day and night, as well as random weather events.
-Collect hundreds of items and craft your own weapons and armor. 
-Explore the limits of crafting and upgrading to forge the strongest gear. 
-Try loads of food to stay alive and cook your own meals Lizards Insects Braised beef.
-Explore a world inspired by real events and real stories.
-Fight a wide range of enemies, including wild beasts and rebel soldiers. Can you survive attacks from all your enemies and extremely difficult bosses?

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
A comprehensive improvement of the game UI
All occupations can be unlocked by mileage
Optimize the game operating efficiency

Added game review feature. Please give us a high five if you like our game!
Fixed a few player reported bugs, many thanks to the folks!

1.Add a moon phase feature that provides a buff effect according to the moon phase
2.Add mooncake recipes which can be shared between different characters
3.Improved game accessibility and performance
4.Bug fixes

1.Add a new storyline, you will face a new threat on your journey
2.Add a new enemy: child soldier and a new location: training camp
3.Add letters and notes which reveals more details of the new storyline
4.Bug fix

We wish you all a happy new year 2018! 
DLC 50% off until 2/24

This big update includes:
1. A brand new card progression system that allows you to gather card shards from the game and then upgrades the card to provide additional attributes to your character. Attributes provided by the card take effect for all characters and a new game can immediately get the bonus on attributes
2. Added Chinese New Year red envelopes, from 2018.2.16 to 2018.3.1, player can collect envelopes with card shards every day
3. Added traditional Chinese snacks, can be randomly found through the journey

In addition, we also provide an "Endless Mode" DLC to purchase, which includes:

1. Endless mode made up of random level elements that players can get a lot of card fragments in this mode
2. 5 new characters, including adventurer who gains more experience and brawler who is good at combat

We hope you will enjoy!

***Critical bug fix: now you can access to DLC content after purchase***

2. Six new top tier recipes - which set will you choose? A set of expensive, flexible, and formidable Force gear or a set of inexpensive, rigid, and highly defensive Fortified gear?
3. Adjusted amount of shards collected from Endless Mode.
